# Review a38 step 05 rr4 — gen (70 generated files)

Method: all 70 entries loaded from s4-gen.json and cross-checked against step-05-records/*.jsonl and step-04 prior slots. I resolved the source owner of all 174 skill-copy references and all 262+86 dynamic tuples by script. I read pinned bytes (95301cb9a) for provenance headers and the windows of about 25 render-join items.

- 66 skill-copy files: ok on outcome. Four of them have a record-text note, listed below.

  - `.claude/skills/distill/scripts/*` (2 files).

- 4 docs outputs: ok on outcome, with one Lead-judgment question.

## Checks

1. **Really generated.** Confirmed for all 70.
   - The skill `SKILL.md` and reference copies carry the line "Generated by fgOS skill assembly from <source> ... Do not edit this copy". Where it is not in the first 12 lines it sits right after the frontmatter (distill, clarifying, discovering, shaping, indexing, researching).
   - The `.agents/.../distill.mjs` and `migrate-porting-state-backfill.mjs` and their `.claude/skills` copies are byte-identical git blobs to core/skills (b859c135, b0db8c74). This matches the `copyDirRecursive` mirror in `src/setup/skill-wrappers.mjs`. No header is possible for scripts.
   - `docs/doc-registry.md` says "generated by `fgos doc-registry` — never hand-edit". The other three docs outputs name their generators (`decision-index.mjs`, `knowledge-projection.mjs`, `enduser-index-generate.mjs`).
2. **No diff or rollbackDiff on any of the 70.** Every record has diff and rollbackDiff null.
3. **Dispositions are only parked, render-join or reject-preserve.**
   - Skill copies: 166 render-join and 8 parked references. Dynamic tuples are 262 REJECT/preserve and 86 ADMIT/preserve; see Q2.
   - Docs outputs: 2,402 parked references (the rest of the 1,910 + 166 + 86 + 277 totals are the four docs files) and 15 REJECT/preserve tuples.
4. **R2: a generated reference follows its source owner.**
   - Every render-join resolves to a real source record item: a Step 5 reference, an author-added slot, or an inherited Step 4 slot. The owner file equals `sourceRenderProvenance.sourceFile`. The matched text equals the owner's text.
   - 144 owners are preserve and 22 are patch. All 166 render-joins are consistent.
   - All 8 parks have a parked owner: executor-dispatch-fallback L240/L312 and fgos-clarifying (docs/decisions/0026, Step 4 dead-link park with successor note h-36d872fbb0e5.md), and fgos-coding-knowledge (docs/architect/knowledge-registry-redesign.md). The park reason cites the exact owner slot key. 4 of the 8 are `plugins/fgOS/skills/**` copies.
   - Every generated dynamic tuple carries `sourceOwner` and `sourceOwnerDisposition`. Admission and disposition equal the owner's in all cases. Operand text equals the owner's. Every ADMIT has a `pathOperand`. Every REJECT has a `nonDocumentUse`.
   - The 16 distinct author-added REJECT owners (`author-s4-reject-*`) are true non-document uses: prose words such as "directly:", "path:", "paths:" and "directory:", plus `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` root substitution. I read `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}`, `root=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir ...)`, the `root=$(...)` prose, "directory: CONTEXT.md's" and "paths:` (files/contracts it may change)" in the pinned bytes.
5. **Window sampling.** I compared the generated line and the owner's source line, byte for byte after the header offset, for all 174 render-joins. About 25 were read in detail, covering docs/history, docs/how-to patches, docs/specs/runner.md patches, docs/distillery preserves and the docs/tutorials, docs/reference, docs/explanation preserves. 158 match exactly. The other 16 are the pointer errors below.

## Record-text notes (outcome unaffected: wrong owner id, same disposition)

A render-join `reason` names a source owner at a different occurrence of the same literal. The correct owner exists and is also preserve. Each should be repointed. Each twin in `plugins/fgOS/skills/**` has the same pointer, listed after the `.agents` id.

| generated file (and twin) | ref | gen line | points to (line) | should point to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| _shared/executor-dispatch-fallback.md | reference-000020, reference-000028 (plugins: 002324, 002332) | 225 | reference-000281 (151) | reference-000282 (224), or its inherited twin slot at 224 |
| distill/scripts/migrate-porting-state-backfill.mjs (and `.claude` copy, reference-000106) | reference-000043 | 21 | reference-000288 (3) | reference-000290 (21) |
| fgos-coding-exploring/SKILL.md | reference-000053 (plugins: 002361) | 132 | skills-094 (15) | skills-096 (131) |
| fgos-coding-planning/references/bootstrap-and-lane.md | reference-000070 (plugins: 002378) | 26 | skills-106 (7) | skills-108 (25) |
| fgos-coding-planning/references/verify-sync-and-gap.md | reference-000073, reference-000077 (plugins: 002381, 002385) | 69 | reference-002280 (64) | reference-002281 (68) |

- The `.agents/` side contains 6 of the 16 mismatching refs (000020, 000028, 000043, 000053, 000070, 000073, 000077 are the generated ids; 000020 and 000028 are one pair, as are 000073 and 000077). The `.claude` copy adds 1 (000106) and the `plugins/` twins add 8.
- Two generated refs duplicate each other's owner on purpose (each pair above), which suggests the owner was keyed by text, not by line.
- The `generated` `reason` strings for refs with inherited owners embed the whole slotKey JSON. That is verbose but resolvable.

## Lead-judgment questions

- **Q1. docs-output parks (4 files, 2,402 references).** These have no source file. The park is justified under R4's generator-seam clause and names a per-line path. The requirement string is the same per file (for example "requires folded view.docs/topics rows including currentPath, aliases and purposeTitle"). Whether that is specific enough for R4 is your call. I see no better outcome, because these are rows serialised from state and registry data, not hand-written passages. I would accept.
- **Q2. ADMIT dynamic tuples in generated `.mjs` copies (86) use disposition `preserve` plus `sourceOwner`, not `render-join`.** The prompt lists render-join, parked or reject-preserve as the expected set. The schema and checker apparently allow it. If you want a strict reading of R2, these 86 would be render-join. The outcome is the same either way: they follow a preserved source operand.
- **Q3. Inherited Step 4 slots in fgos-indexing/SKILL.md line 62.**
  - The `docs/specs/reading-map.md` item is a patch (to docs/reading-map.md#5-...). On the same line the quoted names `docs/how-to/`, `docs/tutorials/`, `docs/reference/`, `docs/explanation/` are preserve.
  - R7 says one outcome per same-line passage, but the actual operations are disjoint: a pointer repair versus quoted directory names. The source part's reviewers should confirm. The generated copies just follow.
- **Q4. The 4 docs-output parks include references into docs/specs/** and docs/architect/** (35 + 2 in decisions/index.md).** They are parked, not preserved on a "retained" witness, so R8 is respected.
